reader_question: Do Republicans and Democrats agree on a ban on stock trading by members of Congress?
grade_line: Documented: a published survey, as the atlas records it
title: Republican and Democratic voters favored a ban on stock trading by members of Congress at almost the same rate in a May 2023 survey, 87 and 88 percent.
measure_line: Registered voters who favor a ban on stock trading by members of Congress, percent, by party, survey fielded May 19 to 30, 2023, United States.
notes: The survey of 2,625 registered voters asked about a ban in general.

The Program for Public Consultation gives a margin of error of plus or minus 1.9 percentage points for the whole sample, with no confidence level stated and none by party, so the survey cannot tell the two parties’ rates apart.
alt: A table of three rows: 86 percent of all registered voters, 87 percent of Republicans and 88 percent of Democrats favored a ban on stock trading by members of Congress in a May 2023 survey.
